prompt: Review whether Texas Instruments has a material causal relationship to nearshoring and friendshoring manufacturing capacity through US 300mm investment and CHIPS support; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: US semiconductor incentives and economic-security priorities can support Texas Instruments' domestic 300mm capacity build, improving supply resilience, utilization and unit costs if qualified demand fills the factories.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if CHIPS support is immaterial to per-share returns, regional capacity merely duplicates global supply, utilization remains weak, fixed costs offset incentives, or customer demand does not reward domestic supply resilience.
